final: WITH per_tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mi FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING COUNT(modindex) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mi) AS o FROM per_tel), above AS (SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mi FROM per_tel p, overall WHERE p.avg_mi > overall.o), above_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mi) AS m FROM above) SELECT a.telescref, a.avg_mi AS avg_modindex, a.avg_mi - overall.o AS diff_from_overall, a.avg_mi / above_mean.m AS ratio_to_above_mean FROM above a, overall, above_mean ORDER BY ratio_to_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10
